1. Install the package mlbench and use the follows to import the data

```{r}
library(caret)
library(mlbench)
library(tidyverse)
data(PimaIndiansDiabetes)
df <- tibble(PimaIndiansDiabetes)
```

Train and Test a decision tree and a random forest with caret. Plot the variable importance of these models. 

```{r}
library(caret)
# Set the target variable
df <- df %>% rename(target=diabetes)
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(target = as.factor(target))
splitIndex <- createDataPartition(df$target, p = .80, 
                                  list = FALSE)
df_train <- df[ splitIndex,]
df_test <- df[-splitIndex,]

#Decision Tree 
model1 <- train(target~., data=df_train, 
                method = "rpart2",
                maxdepth=3)
pred <- predict(model1, df_test)
cm <- confusionMatrix(data = pred, reference = df_test$target, positive = "pos")
cm$overall[1]

#Forest 

model2 <- train(target~., data=df_train, 
                method = "rf",
                ntree = 1000) 
pred <- predict(model2, df_test)
cm <- confusionMatrix(data = pred, reference = df_test$target, positive = "pos")
cm$overall[1]

varImp(model1)
varImp(model2)

plot(varImp(model1))
plot(varImp(model2))

```


2. Train and Test a `glmnet` model. Plot the variable importance of the model. 


```{r}

library(caret)
library(glmnet)


# Train glmnet model
glmnet_model <- train(
  target ~ .,
  data = df_train,
  method = "glmnet",
  trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5)
)

# View model
glmnet_model

# Predictions on test set
pred_glmnet <- predict(glmnet_model, newdata = df_test)

# Confusion matrix
cm_glmnet <- confusionMatrix(
  data = pred_glmnet,
  reference = df_test$target
)

# Accuracy
cm_glmnet$overall["Accuracy"]

plot(varImp(glmnet_model))
```

3. Train and test two models that are not `ranger`, `glmnet` or `rpart`  with caret. If possible, plot the variable importance of the model. 


```{r}
library(caret)

# Logistic Regression
log_model <- train(
  target ~ .,
  data = df_train,
  method = "glm",
  family = "binomial"
)

log_pred <- predict(log_model, df_test)

log_cm <- confusionMatrix(log_pred, df_test$target)

log_acc <- log_cm$overall["Accuracy"]

# Variable Importance
plot(varImp(log_model),
     main = "Variable Importance - Logistic Regression")


# K-Nearest Neighbors
knn_model <- train(
  target ~ .,
  data = df_train,
  method = "knn",
  preProcess = c("center", "scale")
)

knn_pred <- predict(knn_model, df_test)

knn_cm <- confusionMatrix(knn_pred, df_test$target)

knn_acc <- knn_cm$overall["Accuracy"]


# Compare Accuracies
data.frame(
  Model = c("Logistic Regression", "KNN"),
  Accuracy = c(log_acc, knn_acc)
)

```
